skill.summary: 提供QQ邮箱公开和登录可见邮件列表及标签未读数的主题、发件人、时间等元信息摘要与提醒。

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of qq-mail-hot-trend skill for QQ邮箱摘要与提醒
- Supports non-sensitive info summaries from visible personal and public share pages
- Provides unread count, subject, sender, and time summaries within logged-in view
- Extracts titles and summaries from public share links
- Does not support automated send/receive or login interactions
